searchText: Will the initial base fee be 1gwei? It's mentioned in the EIP, but I'm not sure if that decision is settled, as others are TBD. I'm asking this to make sure that Hardhat Network behaves like mainnet when forking from a remote network that doesn't have EIP-1559 activated The fork has already happened on two test networks, with the initial base fee of 1 gwei. Afaik there is no reason to change that for mainnet, and all the reason to keep it. thanks <@!397389662085185547>
